t: Solvent-free, neutral cure sealant for use around sanitary fittings and areas of high humidity, providing a water-resistant seal. Mould, heat and UV-resistant with excellent resistance to water. Non-corrosive towards metal. Adheres to ceramics, glass, enamel, stainless steel and many plastics.
b: Suitable for Sanitaryware, Wash Basins, Bath Tubs, Shower Trays & Window Frames
